title: Nice look but not soft
text: Nice look but not soft. These are nice pillow covers and they are on trend for the plaid look this holiday season. I paired them with black and white plaid and red sweater knit pillows. These covers are noticeably rougher than my black and white ones. They do not feel soft and the fabric feels a little stiff. I’m hoping after we ‘break’ them in a little they will feel softer and more comfortable.
